item.title: Lebanese displaced by war fill Beirut's streets, upending city life
item.summary: Beirut is bursting under a massive wave of displaced people as Israel’s attacks and evacuation orders drive families out of southern and eastern Lebanon and the southern suburbs

item.title: Oil-thirsty Asian nations seek Russian crude as Iran war strains supplies
item.summary: Asian nations are increasingly competing for Russian crude oil as an energy crisis mounts amid the U.S. and Israeli war in Iran, which has choked off roughly a fifth of the world’s oil supply

item.title: Pope Leo XIV urges an Easter end to the US-Israel war on Iran, calling for dialogue
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV expressed hope that the U.S.-Israel war on Iran could end before Easter

item.title: Hiker's dog lost in forest rescued by helicopter after strangers fund search
item.summary: A lost border collie has been rescued alive after her owner fell from a tall waterfall in New Zealand bush

item.title: Czech police arrest a man who claimed responsibility for attack in Prague
item.summary: Czech police say they have arrested a foreign man who claims he threw Molotov cocktails at a Russian cultural center in Prague last week

item.title: Fire and explosions cause panic near military camp in Burundi
item.summary: Residents of an area near a military camp in Burundi fled on Tuesday night after explosions were heard coming from the camp, due to what the army spokesperson later said was a fire caused by an electrical fault at the armory

item.title: Japan deploys its first long-range missiles
item.summary: Japan has deployed its first long-range missile at a southwestern army camp as the country accelerates its offensive capability in response to growing global challenges, including an increasingly assertive China

item.title: Wolf bites woman in a shopping area in Germany's 2nd-biggest city
item.summary: Authorities say a wolf has bitten a woman in a Hamburg shopping area, in what experts call Germany’s first known wild wolf attack on a person since 1998

item.title: Cuba to introduce two new banknotes honoring women to ease inflation as crises persist
item.summary: Cubans accustomed to shopping with wads of bills stuffed into bags because of skyrocketing inflation will get some relief Wednesday when two new high-denomination banknotes go into circulation

item.title: Mongolia's third prime minister in a year faces political infighting and external crises
item.summary: Mongolia’s parliament has confirmed Uchral Nyam-Osor as prime minister to break a political deadlock and try to calm economic fears
